description: This file defines an interface 'IStreamSubscriptionObserver' in the 'Orleans.Streams.Core' namespace. The interface includes a method 'OnSubscribed', which is called when a grain receives a message for a stream it has not yet subscribed to or resumed, indicating its role in stream subscription notification within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Method invoked when a grain receives a message for a stream it hasn't yet subscribed to or resumed. It takes a handle factory as a parameter and returns a Task.
